intent: A content-safety policy node: ask eight semantic checks (prohibited / PII on public feed / age blocking / context blocking at blocking or review severity) plus an effective severity score; the primary question is the score question (not the first question) and the threshold action reads it; label BLOCK when any blocking condition holds or severity >= 90, REVIEW when any review condition holds or severity >= 50, otherwise ALLOW; carry the request and content ids through.

known_steps.text: a choice question "is_prohibited" asks "Does the content hit a prohibited semantic category (never allowed in any context)?"
a score question "effective_severity" asks "Effective severity 0-100 (base taxonomy severity plus repeat-violation boost up to +30)."
the workflow runs at most 5 iterations
label "BLOCK" when the answer to "is_prohibited" is "B"

unknown_steps.text: a multiple choice "is_prohibited" asks "Does it hit a prohibited category?"
a boolean question "is_prohibited" asks "Does it hit a prohibited category?"
label "BLOCK" if the answer to "is_prohibited" equals "B"
the primary question is set to "effective_severity"
